step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram shows a global serverless log ingestion and analytics pipeline for Shopfully. Global mobile clients in different AWS regions send events to CloudFront. A Lambda@Edge function routes incoming events to Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose as a central collector. Kinesis Data Firehose sends data to Kinesis Data Analytics, which uses an inline Lambda function to classify incoming events into critical business, low priority, or drop classes. Firehose also backs up raw events directly to Amazon S3. In case of issues, data can be replayed from S3 back to Kinesis Firehose. Finally, AWS Glue performs ETL on the backup data in S3, exposing it for querying via Amazon Athena.
